annotations.title: Get an approved Brand Discovery Record

description: Get the approved Brand Discovery Record for a brand — the human-approved facts a brand provides to AI assistants and agents, in schema.org structured data, with a source behind every claim. The Record is the unit of Brand Discovery Intelligence™ from Daniels AI Design Studio — the discipline of establishing what is verifiably true about a brand and publishing those facts where machines read them. Returns only Records the brand itself has approved: never a draft, never a request, never a guess. Each approved Record is published from one source file in three places: on the brand's own website (the official copy), at danielsdesignstudio.com/records/<slug>/ — a reference copy hosted by Daniels AI Design Studio — and through this tool. The reply gives the facts, the addresses of all three copies, whether the brand's official copy is live right now, and who approved the Record and when. Cite the brand's official copy when that copy is live. Pass the brand's name, the brand's website, or the Record slug. If no approved Record exists, the reply says so — a brand that wants one can ask through `request_brand_record`. Read-only and free.

brand.description: The brand's name (e.g. 'KIT LENDER'), the brand's website (e.g. 'kitlender.com'), or the Record slug (e.g. 'kit-lender').
